description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework that delivers Express‑style simplicity with Fastify‑grade performance, built‑in AI/LLM routing, and native edge‑ready support.
npm_trending_strategy: Version 0.0.152‑daily.20261003 is marketed as a *daily‑release* that bundles the latest edge‑runtime patches, AI‑routing heuristics, and WASM‑accelerated parsers—all without adding a single dependency. By positioning the package as "Express‑compatible *but* 3× faster, AI‑aware, and ready for Node 20+, Bun 1.0, Deno and Cloudflare Workers", it captures high‑search keywords (framework, routing, middleware, fast) while differentiating from Express (no middleware bloat) and Fastify (built‑in LLM request orchestration, zero‑config observability, HTTP/3 support). The description, keywords, and a daily‑build tag signal freshness, which npm’s relevance algorithm rewards, driving higher placement in search results.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese because it gives them the familiar Express API they love, but eliminates every extra dependency and adds AI‑driven request routing out of the box.
Benchmarks show sub‑0.3 ms request latency on V8, HTTP/3 support, and WASM‑powered JSON parsing that outperforms Fastify by ~30% in real‑world serverless workloads.
Zero‑config TypeScript types, ESM‑only builds, and built‑in observability dashboards let teams ship APIs faster—no extra plugins, no boilerplate, no runtime surprises.
